text_block_list.text:
Dawn broke on the new year. Yaeno Muteki 
came by to offer her greetings.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, Happy New Year. I look 
forward to working with you again this 
year.
choice_data_list: Same here, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The Classic Year is finally upon us. 
Feeling that I must not let this crucial 
year go to waste, I shall go train at my 
family's dojo."

To plan for what lies ahead, I feel like I 
need to find out what kind of training 
Yaeno Muteki went through.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If it is merely observing. I 
believe participating would be a bit 
difficult.

"Training at the Kongo Yaegaki style dojo 
really is quite harsh. I'd best know my 
place and just observe."
...Even that thought proved to be naive.

Just standing here makes my toes freeze. 
Even layered up in fleece, knitwear, a 
down jacket, and thermal underwear, it's 
still freezing cold.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Deep inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Seiyah!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Taah!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Naive! Take that!!

How can Yaeno Muteki and the others stay 
so calm while dressed so lightly...!

Once again, I was struck by how deeply 
conditioned both her mind and body were.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-dono, have you warmed up yet?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Here, have some miso soup. Warming up 
from the inside out is far more 
effective."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"I apologize that we only have simple 
leftovers, but please, help yourself. 
Yaeno prepared the rice balls."

It would be rude to turn down such 
kindness, so I accept. I take a bite of 
the rice ball, said to be handmade by 
Yaeno Muteki.

The fluffy rice gently unravels in your 
mouth. The rich aroma of the rice spreads, 
growing sweeter with every chew. You 
finish the whole thing in the blink of an 
eye!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Perhaps it is because our 
household cooks its rice over a 
traditional hearth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"To bring out the full flavor of rice, 
cooking it in a traditional hearth is 
truly the best way."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“—That being said, my skills fall far 
short of my gran... my grandmother's.”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. It was cooked up all 
fluffy and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, my instincts were dull since it 
had been a while... Truth be told, I was a 
bit anxious about the heat control.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Consistency in daily practice is key, 
after all. My goal for this year is to 
never miss a day of building upon my 
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I would also like to hear your opinion, 
Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In this Classic year, what kind of 
training would be best for me to pursue?

What I want to recommend Yaeno Muteki to 
train this year is—
choice_data_list: Make sure to get your rest.
I want to master a special move...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, indeed, relying solely on my 
self-taught training may have led to an 
unbalanced regimen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
It seems you've done a wonderful job 
guiding my granddaughter, who tends to get 
tunnel vision.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If that be the case, should the focus of 
our training for now ...be running power?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In my humble opinion, the training in 
Kongo Yaegaki lacks sufficient endurance 
running.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, strike while the iron is 
hot. Let us make haste.

"And then, borrowing the grounds of a 
nearby school, they carried out distance 
running training."

I told Yaeno Muteki that since she trains 
diligently every day, what she really 
needs is plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That sounds about right. Even back 
when she practiced at home, she had a 
tendency to overdo things a bit.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Since it's your day off, why don't you go 
out somewhere and have some fun?

And on the old lady's recommendation, she 
headed over to a nearby ranch.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh! Such round little eyes and a pink 
little nose... Ah, reaching out so 
desperately with those tiny paws...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... So cute... I just want to 
protect them...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Just looking at it cleanses my soul...

"Watching the animals grazing peacefully 
in the pasture, Yaeno Muteki seemed to 
feel thoroughly refreshed!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A special move... You mean like a 
signature weapon that clinches the race?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... However, secret arts are not 
something that can be mastered overnight.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
In martial arts as well, only after 
extensive experience and tireless pursuit 
can one discover the ultimate secret.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...My 'Unification of Fire and Water' is a 
Yaegaki technique. If so, mastering the 
Yaegaki style may well be the path to an 
ultimate move.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Master, would you grant me a sparring 
session?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Here I go!!

Yaeno Muteki trained under her 
grandfather, the grandmaster of the Kongo 
Yaegaki style, and gained valuable 
insight!
